app.title: Nearest station? The app already knows.
app.sub: It finds stations, rents with a scan and manages your rental. Prefer to skip it? Scanning the QR on a station is enough.

features.title: Find a station nearby
features.text: A map of the stations around you and the way to the closest one. No more panic-hunting for an outlet.

features.title: Rent in seconds
features.text: Scan the QR, confirm payment and the power bank is released. No sign-up, no forms.

features.title: Manage and return
features.text: See your active rental and return it at any station, not only the one you took it from.

features.title: In four languages
features.text: Hebrew, English, Arabic and Russian. The battery may run out, but never the words.

pay.title: Pay your way
pay.text: Apple Pay, Google Pay or a credit card. The authorization on your card or digital wallet is confirmed the moment the power bank is released.
pay.rates: First hour free. After that ₪12 per hour, capped at ₪50 per day. No subscription, no hidden fees.

dl.title: Get the app
dl.noapp: No app needed: scan the QR on any station with your phone camera and rent right away.
